duties.scope: Bounded local computation and declared admitted observations; no global CPU/heap or malicious-code guarantee.

Feasibility, optimality, complete tied consequences and policy choice are separate; unresolved sources remain outside repair minimization.

Selected information, domain, unit and fixed-feature transformations have explicit evidence; numeral recoding alone supplies no operational equivalence.
Fixed-profile and rebuilding-procedure expected-performance audits under named episode laws; not self-proof, report-dependent reflection or unpriced self-assessment.
